ios.title: Tidal Tiles: Block Puzzle
ios.subtitle: Relaxing Brain Game
ios.description:
Tidal Tiles is a calm wood block puzzle that plays like a breath of sea air.

Drop wooden tiles onto the grid, fill rows, columns and 3x3 squares, and watch the tide wash them away. No timer, no lives, no pressure — just you, the board and the sound of waves.

WHY PLAYERS STAY
• Classic block puzzle rules with a sudoku twist: clear squares, not just lines
• Play offline — no wifi needed on the train, on a plane or at the beach
• Daily Tide: one new hand-made board every day
• 300+ calm levels that slowly teach smarter moves
• Soft ocean sounds and haptics you can turn off

A brain game for adults who want to unwind, not to grind. Easy to learn, satisfying to master.

Tidal Tiles is free to play. Optional ads can be removed with a one-time purchase.
